shots.caption: My boy Wilfred makes shirts. Not many people left who can.
New competition out of China does it for a tenth of the price. Fine.
What actually finished him was the regulations. He ties a buttonhole how his hands know it, not how the form says it should look.
So on paper, every piece he makes fails.
I told him: sell it anyway.
A man's whole life's work doesn't stop being correct just because a form disagrees with it.
You want a guy for your next shirt? Hop over to soldanyway.com.
